summary: End-to-end frontend testing of Argelia QR landing page on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). All 15 requested feature checks passed. Loading screen disappears within ~3s; hero CTA scrolls; language switcher (ES/FR/EN) works; all 7 nav links navigate; History (5 eras + martyrs), Famous People (5 cards + modal open/close), Landscapes (11 bento cards), Gastronomy (5 dishes), Why Visit (4 stats + 4 pillars), SVG Algeria Map + info panel, Media (3 cards), Footer (Houari + 5 social links) all render and function. Mobile menu trigger and close work. No JS errors; only one benign Canvas2D willReadFrequently performance hint.
action_items: (Optional/minor) Add data-testid='map-pin-{i}' to individual map pin markers in AlgeriaMap.jsx for hover testing of each city pin. Pins render visually and the info panel updates on hover in the UI, but there is no per-pin testid for automated hover assertions.
(Optional) Add willReadFrequently:true on Canvas2D context in Particles.jsx to silence the perf warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Pins inside AlgeriaMap.jsx lack individual data-testid attributes - acceptable but limits granular hover testing.
Single Canvas2D perf warning from particle canvas - low impact, can set willReadFrequently:true when calling getContext('2d').
context_for_next_testing_agent: All major data-testids exist and function. Loading screen ~2.5s. Language switcher uses dropdown trigger (lang-switcher-trigger) and options (lang-option-es/fr/en). Person modal opens on person-card click and closes via person-modal-close. Map shows 'Explora el mapa' default panel; hovering pins updates panel but pins lack per-pin testids.
